scope: Local redesign and functionality/SEO improvement; no publication, push, deployment, database change or indexing request.

baseline.head: 3bcb5f8455e5316258e252b7602766390ce9b36b
baseline.workingTree: Contains the separate uncommitted Text Similarity Checker work; both tools remain local.
baseline.liveAudit: Previous page accepted JSON arrays/objects via JSON.parse, flattened with dot notation and offered delimiter choice. No wrapped-API row selection, JSON Lines, column controls, preview, number-token preservation or formula-risk handling; generic FAQs.
observedProblems: Large integers and decimal spellings were altered by JavaScript number parsing.
Nested keys containing dots could collide with flattened paths.
Multiline CSV values broke row counting in the preview.
Wrapped API responses (e.g. {data:{items:[...]}}) could not be converted without manual editing.
No column selection/order, no table preview, no spreadsheet formula protection.

keywordResearch.method: Keywords chosen from the existing tools keyword export (docs/tools-keywords-2026-09-28.json) and common query wording; no new volume data.
keywordResearch.limitations: No measured search volume, keyword difficulty, rankings, click forecast or fresh authenticated GSC report.

implementation.positioning: Local nested JSON / JSON Lines to CSV converter with explicit row-source selection and spreadsheet-safety review. Existing URL and canonical retained.

added: jsonc-parser 3.3.1 (strict tokenizing, duplicate-key detection, original number tokens)

implementation.parsing: Strict JSON and JSON Lines; comments, trailing commas, BOM in JSONL, duplicate keys (including escaped equivalents) rejected with line numbers. Number tokens are preserved as source text, never through Number().
implementation.rows: Inspection lists candidate row sources as RFC 6901 JSON Pointers (up to 60) with counts; wrapper metadata outside the selected array is excluded and disclosed.
implementation.columns: Flatten nested objects or keep JSON cells; one optional array expansion into repeated rows (no Cartesian product); array cells as JSON or scalar join; column select/rename/reorder/filter with unique-header validation (also after protection prefixing). __proto__/constructor/dotted keys remain distinct inert data.
implementation.export: Delimiter (, ; tab |), CRLF/LF, header on/off, BOM, quote-all, separate null/missing replacements, formula-risk apostrophe prefixing with counts (negative JSON numbers unchanged). Copy full CSV or download; 50k-character text preview with paginated table preview of actual exported values.
implementation.limits: 1,000,000 characters / 2 MiB input; depth 40; 200k nodes; 10,000 rows; 200 columns; 250k cells; 8 MiB output; 15-second cancellable worker deadline.
implementation.privacy: Module Worker conversion; no fetch/API/AI/storage in the conversion source graph (AST-verified). Work is not saved automatically. Sitewide analytics/ads are separate; no absolute all-site privacy claim.

seo.title: Free JSON to CSV Converter - Nested JSON & JSON Lines

seo.structuredData: WebApplication, BreadcrumbList and five FAQs matching visible content. No invented reviews or aggregate ratings.
seo.discovery: Central tool catalog, homepage, llms.txt and chatbot tool catalog describe the nested/JSON Lines scope; related links retained including the invoice route.
seo.image: Custom 1200x630 PNG Open Graph/Twitter image with fictional JSON/CSV illustration that agrees with the engine.

measurementPlan: After an explicitly approved release, inspect the exact canonical URL in Search Console and compare page/query clicks, impressions and CTR over complete comparable 28-day periods, or 90 days if sparse. Check indexing before inferring a cause. No analytics instrumentation added.
